_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve mixed_poisson#2, a signal-text correction. The prior text cited `KSPSolve: DIVERGED_INDEFINITE_PC`, which is a PETSc message that NGSolve never emits. Measured on 6.2.2604: with the BDM_1 x L2(1) mis-pairing, a.mat.Inverse(X.FreeDofs(), inverse='umfpack') prints 'UMFPACK V5.7.4 (Feb 1, 2016): WARNING: matrix is singular' and then raises NgException('UmfpackInverse: Numeric factorization failed.'). The fixture also asserts the PETSc string is ABSENT from what NGSolve produced.
